prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2005 – Summary (within 500 words)

Core principles and funding
- Principles: Freedom, Fairness, Trust, with a strong “green thread” across all policies and active internationalism.
- Costings: Reprioritise about £5bn/year by abolishing ID cards, redirecting the Child Trust Fund to schools, and scrapping/streamlining DTI subsidies; figures checked against official costings.
- Fairer taxes: Replace Council Tax with a Local Income Tax (typical household saves ~£450/yr). Introduce a 50% rate only on income over £100,000 to fund: scrapping tuition/top-up fees, free personal care for the elderly/disabled, and lower local taxes.

Health
- Free personal care, as in Scotland.
- Faster diagnosis for serious conditions; more scans in evenings/weekends; publish test waiting times.
- Abolish charges for eye and dental check-ups; widen prescription charge exemptions.
- Recruit at least 8,000 doctors, 12,000 nurses, 18,000 therapists/scientists by 2008; cut central targets/bureaucracy; local democratic accountability.
- Reform NHS dentistry; personal care plans; expand palliative care; end age discrimination; ban smoking in enclosed public places; improve school nutrition.

Education and skills
- Abolish tuition/top-up fees; restore grants for poorer students.
- Use £1.5bn Child Trust Fund to hire 21,000 teachers; cut infant classes to avg 20 and junior to 25; extended school hours; accelerate Children’s Centres.
- Guarantee qualified subject teachers in core subjects; reduce high-stakes testing; stronger discipline plans; better SEN support.
- Create 14–19 diplomas blending academic/vocational; close schools–colleges funding gap; maintain statutory free school transport distances.
- Green every new education building.

Crime, justice and liberty
- Scrap ID cards; fund 10,000 extra police and complete +20,000 CSOs; cut police red tape/boost tech.
- Tough, restorative community sentences; local say via Community Justice Panels.
- Tackle alcohol-related disorder; make large venues fund late-night policing.
- Make prisons teach skills with a full working day; reduce reoffending.
- Protect civil liberties: repeal flawed control order law; admit intercept evidence; judges to authorise any control orders.
- Fair asylum: independent agency, allow asylum seekers to work; Single Equality Act; hate crime units.

Economy and business
- Fiscal stability: NAO scrutiny of Budgets; independent ONS; uphold fiscal rules.
- Stamp duty threshold to £150,000 (help ~150,000 buyers).
- Support EU reform; prepare for euro entry via referendum when conditions met; managed economic migration.
- Cut red tape: impact tests, sunset clauses, single inspections; small business rate relief (up to £1,500); rate base on site value.
- Abolish DTI, reinvest savings in education/skills; legal duty to trade fairly; boost English tourism.
- Green economy: convert Climate Change Levy to Carbon Tax; incentives for cleaner cars/homes; ≥20% electricity from renewables by 2020; no new nuclear replacements.

Pensions and benefits
- Citizen’s Pension from 75: at least £109.45 (single) and £167.05 (couple), earnings-linked; removes means-testing for ~1m.
- Replace Council Tax with Local Income Tax—8 in 10 pensioners pay less; 6m poorer pensioners pay none.
- Maternity Income Guarantee: £170/week for first 6 months for first child.
- Reform New Deal; scrap CSA—move assessment/enforcement to Inland Revenue; tribunal for special cases.
- Winter Fuel Payment for severely disabled; allow insulation vouchers; strengthen pension loss compensation; cut fraud/error via simplification.

Local communities, housing and services
- Local Income Tax; devolve power from Whitehall; merge inspectorates.
- Build 100,000 affordable homes on public land; reform VAT to favour brownfield/empty buildings reuse; manage second homes through planning.
- Protect post offices and universal mail service; restore Lottery independence; maintain/raise core arts funding; grassroots sport; 2012 bid support.
- Waste: target 60% household recycling within 7 years; zero-waste goal; sustainable planning rules.

Transport
- Streamline rail franchising; restore postponed upgrades; improve station safety.
- Reward cleaner cars via VED; promote city congestion charging with upfront public transport investment.
- Long-term: replace fuel duty and VED with national road pricing reflecting congestion/pollution.
- Free off-peak local bus travel for all pensioners/disabled; free railcards for pensioners, disabled, families, youth.
- Limit major new roads; expand rail freight, cycling/walking; reform aviation taxes to per-aircraft and include aviation in emissions trading; oppose new SE airports.

International, Europe, defence, development
- Iraq: war was wrong; support democratic transition; aim to withdraw UK troops by end of UN mandate; rebuild via multilateralism.
- EU: support Constitutional Treaty (referendum), more democratic/efficient EU.
- Defence: stop unnecessary programmes (e.g., Eurofighter tranche 3) to fund troop welfare; retain minimum nuclear deterrent while pushing multilateral disarmament; tighter arms export controls; pursue Arms Trade Treaty.
- Development: raise aid to 0.5% GNI by 2007/08 and 0.7% by 2011; end farm export dumping; fairer trade; green, sustainable development and climate leadership (contraction and convergence).

Rural and environment
- Fair food prices: duty to trade fairly; Food Trade Inspector.
- Speed CAP reform towards public goods; support family farms/new entrants.
- Marine Act for fisheries/ecosystems; Animal Protection Commission and comprehensive Welfare Act.
- No commercial GM until proven safe; GM-free zones; promote organic.
- Environmental Responsibility Act; government green procurement; align environment/transport/energy under one department.
